detail: Operator describes sloping walkable grass roof blending into parkland, exposed concrete, glass, copper and the east-facing Regeneration Hall.
Museum confirms the copper-clad hall rises to the east toward the Peace Tower, with Morse-code windows spelling the remembrance message in two languages.
Official fast facts give the canted exterior walls, 10,684 m² of grass and the two window inscriptions LEST WE FORGET and N’OUBLIONS JAMAIS in the Regeneration Hall.
The operator’s 2004–05 annual report states the highest point is 24.5 m and gives the footprint as 19,000 m².
The operator identifies the large window openings, recycled copper and exposed oak and concrete.
